title: [Master Data Management] Fixing synchronization of contacts, media, date, datetime, source watermarking, permission issue and minor UX issues
summary: Master Data Management synchronization is fixed to handle contacts, media caching, date/datetime values, privacy consent errors, and permission issues affecting non-SUPER users.
key_points: Media and watermark cache lifetime now resets only at batch boundaries instead of during ancillary fetches
Privacy consent failures show actionable messages instead of bare 403 errors
Contact synchronization fixed for scenarios where auto-created contacts conflict with existing entries
Blank date and datetime values now synchronize correctly
Permission issues resolved for non-SUPER users accessing Master Data Management features
quote: Media/watermark cache lifetime fix - resets only at the batch boundary (GetModifiedBatch).
